verdict.rationale: Intuit's official QuickBooks Online MCP server and V3 REST API SDKs give an agent create/update operations across QBO entity types, so an agent can plausibly post ledger entries programmatically. Journal entries are never named, and nothing in the pack shows a draft state or review queue where an accountant approves agent-posted entries. Accountant access and custom workflows are only adjacent. Missing for 10: explicit JournalEntry API support, a draft/pending-approval state for agent-created entries, an accountant review queue, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent draft and post journal entries via the API and leave them in a review queue for my accountant

citations.quote: It includes full CRUD operations for 29 entity types and 11 financial reports, giving you comprehensive access to QuickBooks Online functionality.
